items.title: 68097_Freddie Green oral history interview
items.q: Well, there was a friend of mine -- Do you know of Lonnie Simmons ? ... I don't know for sure, but I know his name was Frank Spearmen. And Lonnie Simmons.

ctx.x: And probably you'd heard they needed a banjo, or something, at Yeah Man, or someone you knew told you, or what?
Well, there was a friend of mine -- Do you know of Lonnie Simmons ?
